expected_outputs.description: Validated teardown template for Teardown Template.
expected_outputs.name: teardown

implementation_notes: Extract reusable layout, state, and workflow decisions instead of copying a product's surface style wholesale.
Always pair teardown notes with source-reference rules to reduce copying drift.
known_failure_modes: Teardown Template collapses into screenshots and vibes instead of reusable extracted decisions.
Source boundaries are unclear, so copied assets slip in with the teardown.
name: Teardown Template
problem_solved: Captures reusable decisions from Teardown Template without cloning branding or assets.

required_inputs.description: Which reusable decisions the teardown must extract.
required_inputs.name: capture_scope

summary: Machine-first template for extracting reusable decisions from reference products.

capture_fields.description: Describe how users move through the product.
capture_fields.name: navigation_model

capture_fields.description: Describe selection, collapse, and inspector behavior.
capture_fields.name: state_behavior

do_not_copy: List branding, copy, visual assets, or code that must not be copied.
reusable_decisions: Describe one reusable decision extracted from the teardown.
source_reference_rules: Reference the rule set that governs this teardown.

when_not_to_use: Do not use when Teardown Template is just a screenshot dump with no reusable decisions extracted.
Do not use when source-reference rules are unclear and copying risk is unresolved.
when_to_use: Use when Teardown Template should be dissected into reusable workflow and layout decisions.
Use when Dex needs reference mining without cargo-culting whole products.
